articles.title: After 15 Years, Mathematicians Invent the World's Fairest Dice
articles.summary: Five 60-sided dice, designed over 15 years, make turn order perfectly fair for any group. The math behind them is mind-boggling!

articles.title: Alcaraz Finds His Rhythm: 'I'm Better Than I Thought' at US Open
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz cruised past Wu Yibing to reach the US Open fourth round, saying he's improving each match after a 139-day injury layoff.

articles.title: Jay-Z's London Comeback: Beyoncé Birthday Tribute and a Fugees Reunion
articles.summary: At his first UK headline show in 13 years, Jay-Z serenaded Beyoncé for her 45th birthday and surprised fans with Lauryn Hill and Wyclef Jean.
